question: In which year was Aatmanirbhar Bharat Rojgar Yojana launched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2020.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Aatmanirbhar Bharat Rojgar Yojana (ABRY)** was launched in **2020** as part of the Aatmanirbhar Bharat package.
 
• It aimed to incentivize the creation of new employment opportunities during the post-COVID recovery phase.
 
• The scheme provides subsidies for the provident fund contributions of new employees and their employers.
 
• The objective of ABRY is** to promote formal employment and reduce the adverse impact of COVID-19** on the labor market.
 
• The scheme targeted both new hires and those who had lost their jobs during the pandemic, encouraging businesses to re-hire.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **2018:**

 
 
• No major employment scheme named Aatmanirbhar Bharat Rojgar Yojana was launched in 2018.
 
• Other initiatives like **PM-Kisan and Ayushman Bharat** were introduced around this period.
 
 
 
• **2017:**
 
 
• In 2017, several government programs were introduced, but ABRY was not among them.
 
• Schemes like the **Pradhan Mantri Gramin Digital Saksharta Abhiyan (PMGDISHA) **were prominent in this year.
 
 
 
• **2019:**
 
 
• In 2019, the government focused on various socio-economic schemes, but ABRY was not launched.
 
• The focus was on initiatives like** Jal Jeevan Mission and the continuation of Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana.**
